scripts.dev: docker compose -f apps/marcos-aws/local/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait && NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 bun --env-file=apps/marcos/.env.offline apps/marcos-aws/local/seed.ts && bun run --cwd apps/marcos dev:offline
scripts.test: docker compose -f apps/marcos-aws/local/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait aws && bun --env-file=packages/marcos-core/.env.test apps/marcos-aws/local/seed.ts && bun run --cwd packages/marcos-core test
scripts.test:e2e: docker compose -f apps/marcos-aws/local/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait && bun run e2e:seed && bun run --cwd apps/marcos test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e:ui: docker compose -f apps/marcos-aws/local/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait && bun run e2e:seed && bun run --cwd apps/marcos test:e2e:ui
